context_en: [O1] At the 15 de Abril market in Puerto Villarroel, officers rescued one black-bearded macaw and one capuchin monkey from illegal sale; both were sent to a wildlife holding centre. The lot spans different taxonomic groups; its aggregate should include only actually counted wild specimens, exclude domestic animals and avoid adding the same subgroup to the same event twice. Exact event day remains unconfirmed in this review. Do not infer capture origins, intermediaries or destinations without event-specific evidence. [S1] A 2021 global review examines biodiversity impacts of trade; it cannot estimate affected individuals from this particular event.
